Research Profile

Research focuses on solving nonlinear partial differential equations using both analytical and numerical methods. Currently working on RBF-based meshless methods at GIK Institute for numerical solutions of complex mathematical models including MHD nanofluid flow and nonlinear elastic wave problems.

During MPhil, worked on soliton solutions via New Extended Direct Algebraic, Exp(−φ), (G'/G) and Jacobi Elliptic function methods, and semi-analytic methods including the Variational Iteration Method (VIM) and Adomian Decomposition Method.

Analytical Methods for Nonlinear PDEs RBF Meshless Methods Soliton Theory & Wave Solutions VIM & Adomian Decomposition Scientific Computing
